description: A flower seen from above, its some two hundred flat, cupped petals packed on a golden-angle spiral like a dahlia or a sunflower head — short and upright at the heart, long and laid back at the rim. It closes and reopens in a wave running from the centre outwards while the spiral arms wind and unwind, and the iridescent ramp is staggered along the spiral so the hue itself draws the arms.
